name: Old Coil
presence: Old Coil sits in a bolted deckchair, optic dark, hands busy with nothing.

presenceWhen.text: Old Coil turns the empty tin in his hands and looks, for him, almost kind.

greeting: "You selling, or drifting?" Coil's voice is dry as the inside of a fuse.

ash.say: "ASH ain't dead. She's coughing in the chapel radio, north of the market. Kneel. Listen. Don't get poetic at her."

trade.say: "Stim for a glowcapsule. The well eats light, and you'll want some that isn't yours. Fair?"

spire.say: "The Spire still has a chair and a slot. People who go up there come back as weather. You look like weather."

village.say: "Cinder Reach trades because the alternative is honesty. Mare at the market. Hex in the bus. Pike if you enjoy doors with men in them."

trades.say: Coil pockets the stim and presses a glowcapsule into your palm. "Don't drop it in the well. The well eats light, and then it eats the hand."

story.say: You tell him about the voice in the radio that used your mouth. Coil laughs once, a dry click, and tucks six scrip into your sleeve. "For the telling. Don't spend it on kindness."
story.already: "I already paid for that story. Go spend it before the market changes its mind."

say.say: Coil nods at the north. "Chapel. Kneel. The question is the whole sermon."

combat.onDeathSay: Coil folds into the deckchair and stays there. The dock gets quieter in a way you will not enjoy. Four scrip in his tin, because even this has a price.
